gaps.title: Vehicle and ECU identity
missing_inputs: exact B235/B207 suffix and installed transmission code
ECU hardware/software IDs and calibration hash
gaps.reason: Platform/engine family does not uniquely identify installed software or hardware; join every model input to the actual vehicle configuration.

gaps.title: Traceable logging acquisition
missing_inputs: channel definitions, units and ECU addresses
timestamps, clock alignment and dropped-frame statistics
sensor calibration, range, uncertainty and lag
gaps.reason: Adapter maxima and diagnostic labels cannot establish trustworthy synchronized measurements; validate channels against independent instrumentation.

gaps.title: Measured engine operating maps
missing_inputs: fuel and air mass flow maps
gaps.reason: Factory peak output and ECU-request maps are insufficient for a calibrated performance/economy model; use traceable dynamometer measurements.

gaps.title: Detailed combustion and gas-exchange model
missing_inputs: measured valve-lift curves and valve-flow coefficients
gaps.reason: Advertised events or a synthetic cam plot do not supply measured flow/lift geometry. A detailed B235/B207 engine model needs additional experimental and geometric inputs.

gaps.title: Turbo, charge-air and injector changes
missing_inputs: exact turbo compressor/turbine maps and shaft limits
intercooler pressure loss and heat-transfer maps
gaps.reason: Calibration request/limit maps describe ECU intent; they do not prove physical airflow, fueling capacity or safe component operating margins.

gaps.title: Gearbox and longitudinal drivetrain
gaps.reason: Factory ratios may support kinematic screening, but acceleration and transmission durability need measured torque, losses and dynamics.

gaps.title: Tires, road load and vehicle dynamics
missing_inputs: mass distribution/CG and suspension geometry for lateral studies
coastdown road-load coefficients and aerodynamic area
gaps.reason: Tire dimensions cannot substitute for empirical friction parameters; a longitudinal-only block cannot support handling predictions.

gaps.title: Cooling and underhood heat soak
missing_inputs: coolant/oil pump flow and pressure-loss data
radiator/intercooler geometry or measured UA maps
airflow, thermal masses and contact conductance
gaps.reason: A Saab cooling model requires matched geometry and measured thermal behavior; generic demonstration radiator values are not Saab data.

gaps.title: ECU thermal/electrical reliability
missing_inputs: ECU housing/board geometry and thermal paths
component temperature limits and power dissipation
failure history with exposure and control-group comparison
gaps.reason: Diagnostic temperatures do not reveal ECU junction temperature or full harness stresses; relocation/replacement reliability gains require representative tests and failure evidence.

gaps.title: Hose, clamp and fitting suitability
missing_inputs: diameters, bends, wall thickness and retention geometry
permeation, aging, burst and hot-cycle test results
gaps.reason: Temperature alone does not establish suitability. Silicone coolant and nitrile fuel/PCV families have different exclusions; no Saab replacement fitment was verified.

gaps.title: Structural geometry and material fidelity
missing_inputs: part CAD or measured geometry with tolerances
gaps.reason: Repair illustrations and diagnostic signals do not contain a structural finite-element model. Measure representative parts and validate boundary conditions.

gaps.title: Fatigue and quantitative reliability
missing_inputs: S-N/strain-life data at operating temperature and mean stress
gaps.reason: A stress solution is not a life or failure-probability prediction. Fit and validate against coupon/component tests and representative service data; preserve uncertainty.

gaps.title: Before/after validation and uncertainty
gaps.reason: A numerical change in a generic or fitted model cannot prove a real improvement outside its tested range.

gaps.title: Software and source reuse permissions
missing_inputs: separate rights for ECU firmware and bundled factory documents
gaps.reason: Public readability and repository license metadata do not establish blanket permission to redistribute all code, binaries, manuals or datasets.

gaps.title: Conflicting family catalog text and SKU verification
gaps.reason: Retrieved US PCV/EEC family page contains MIL-DTL-6000/coolant text while GB family excludes cooling service. Preserve conflict and prefer SKU-level manufacturer confirmation.
